name: Shoallhell
tagline: Gloomhaven-style card tactics in the Dungeon Joe world
goal: Two tenants, one seeded dive. Win scenario after scenario, a Depth deeper each time, before the 15 minutes run out.
scoring: 100 per monster killed (Elites 200, bosses 1,000), 150 per door opened, 10 per gold picked up. Every scenario won adds 1,000 × its Depth, 50 per round under 12, and 10 per HP and 20 per card your standing heroes have left. Then the next scenario starts at once.

modifiers.name: Elite Squad
modifiers.text: Every monster is an Elite, even the ones that turn up later.

modifiers.name: Glass Cannon
modifiers.text: Every hero has 2 max HP, but every hero attack gets +3.

modifiers.name: Blessed Day
modifiers.text: Every hero’s attack modifier deck starts each scenario with 15 Bless cards (×2) shuffled in.

modifiers.name: Coin Flip
modifiers.text: Every modifier deck, yours and the monsters’, is ten ×2 and ten ×0. Nothing in between.

modifiers.name: Glowen Flood
modifiers.text: All four elements are always strong, and every card bonus that spends one is free.

modifiers.name: Full Deck
modifiers.text: Heroes bring every card their class has, every level: about twice the usual hand.

modifiers.name: Veterans
modifiers.text: The heroes start at level 5: full health, their best cards and four perks. The monsters do not level up.

modifiers.name: Gary’s Clearance
modifiers.text: Gary is closing down: every hero starts kitted out from his whole stall (helmet, chest, shoes, hands, two potions).

modifiers.name: Boss Rush
modifiers.text: Every room after the first holds a boss (at half health) and only half of its usual pack.

modifiers.name: Swarm Season
modifiers.text: Twice as many monsters, each with half the health.

modifiers.name: Big Shove
modifiers.text: Monster attacks push 1, and every push and pull goes twice as far. Mind the hazards.

modifiers.name: Rush Hour
modifiers.text: Everyone moves 2 further, and every hero move is a Jump.

modifiers.name: Volatile Tide
modifiers.text: Monsters burst when they die: 2 damage to every monster next to them (1 to heroes). Chain reactions welcome.

modifiers.name: Bottomless Hand
modifiers.text: Cards you play go straight back to your hand. Only LOST halves are gone, so no resting needed.

modifiers.name: Gold Rush
modifiers.text: Three times the coins on the floor, a chest in every room, and all gold is worth double (and gold is points).
